author: Palmetto State News
title: Fairfield County Council schedules public hearing on 2026 operating budget ordinance
text:
Fairfield County Council will hold a public hearing on June 8 at 6 p.m. to gather public comment regarding an ordinance to establish operating budgets for the operation of the county government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026.
The council announced on May 27 that residents are invited to attend and provide input on the proposed budget ordinance. The hearing is part of Fairfield County’s ongoing efforts to involve community members in decisions about local governance and financial planning.
Fairfield County supports a variety of services and programs, including athletic activities through parks and recreation, annual festivals, art galleries, historic sites, museums, airport facilities with a 5,243-foot runway, libraries, senior centers, and partnerships with regional agencies. The county has also received recognition for its magnet school in math and science earning the Palmetto Finest School distinction. These initiatives reflect Fairfield County’s focus on quality of life, recreation opportunities, business development, and cultural enrichment for residents and visitors alike, according to the official website .
The upcoming public hearing provides an opportunity for citizens to express their views before final decisions are made regarding funding allocations for these services in the next fiscal year.
